topic: Will humans look physically different in the future?
scientific_reframe: Under which separately modelled processes - transgenerational genetic change, developmental plasticity, environmental exposure, technology-mediated phenotype modification, and demographic composition - could future human populations exhibit measurable changes in selected physical phenotypes, and which claims are forecastable rather than speculative?

included: third-molar agenesis as a carefully bounded dental case study
excluded: race essentialism or ranking of population groups
claims that diet or technology automatically become inherited evolution
unvalidated claims of climate-selected human appearance
